verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a general no-code contract builder, template-based workflows, and e-signature, but nothing in the evidence mentions SAFEs, convertible notes, or pre-built standard-term fundraising instruments. A generic template builder means the user still supplies the document, which is a building block rather than this capability. The 2015 HN comment about pre-loaded 'industry standard' templates does not say these include fundraising instruments.
